nodes.label: Pricing Mechanism Decision
nodes.rationale: Fixed credit per feature (not token-proportional, not subscription-only). Cost-metering runs in parallel for future pricing decisions.

nodes.label: Real Cost Metering
nodes.rationale: LLM cost is NOT the binding constraint — infra fixed cost + market price are. At locked credits × $0.10/credit the margin is ~190x+ over real cost. Cost metering runs in parallel to build pricing data.

nodes.label: Cost Reconciliation Against OpenRouter Invoice
nodes.rationale: Our _estimate_cost_usd from the llm_pricing rate table matches OpenRouter's actual usage.cost to within 0.0–1.1% on every feature/model. Latency 1–8s under the PRD <15s bar.

nodes.label: Server-Side Admin Role Gating
nodes.rationale: RULES.md §2 requires server-side rejection of admin endpoints for non-admin JWTs regardless of what the UI shows. Verified live with HTTP 403 on all admin routes.

nodes.label: Config-Driven Sandbox Executor
nodes.rationale: Switching from public Judge0 CE to self-hosted (or RapidAPI/Sulu) is a config edit — JUDGE0_BASE_URL and JUDGE0_AUTH_HEADERS in .env — not a code rewrite. Preserves run_code(language, code, tests, timeout) interface.

nodes.label: Self-Hosted Judge0 Migration
nodes.rationale: Public Judge0 CE is dev-only; production must self-host for rate limits, reliability, privacy (source code stays in your infra), and determinism (pinned version + resource limits).

nodes.label: Sandbox-Only Code Execution Rule
nodes.rationale: RULES.md §2 requires code execution to route through Judge0 only. Infra failure degrades to clean 503 rather than unsandboxed execution.
